subs.reason: Too weak at AFTER 2.65 (BEFORE 3.37, delta -0.72): the new Fighter/Thief-gated ability system (chooseAbility) is never reachable by a Magic User, so every Summoner run gets zero benefit from this phase's single biggest power add while Fighter/Thief subs pull the pooled mu down (BEFORE 3.75 -> AFTER 3.60); the death causes stay ordinary monster attrition (Gremlin/Philly/Poltergeist), not a self-summon backfire ('eaten by their own summoning' appears only 4 times, Troll cell only) -- no single spell/item number explains the drop, it is structural to the ability gate Phase 38 chose by design. No engine-rule change is in scope this phase.

Too weak at AFTER 2.60 (BEFORE 2.94, delta -0.34): the level-1 Magic User sub already sat at the bottom of the v1.5 BEFORE table (2.94, 24th of 24) with the thinnest spell pool in the game; the same ability-gate structural gap as Summoner above (Fighter/Thief only) applies, compounded by the lower pooled mu shrinking every sub's room in the fine band; ordinary monster attrition dominates every cell's top causes -- no single content number isolates this, it is the class's known floor. No engine-rule change is in scope this phase.
